تستأتون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْتُونَ (tastaʔtūna) /tas.taʔ.tuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# تُسْتَأْتَوْنَ (tustaʔtawna) /tus.taʔ.taw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
